snippet.title: Rocksowers - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4395850/Rocksowers

Rocksowers is a co-op open world survival sandbox focused on challenging bullet hell combat. Explore the corrupted surface on a moving base, gather resources, craft and customize your gear to defeat dangers that lurk outside.
